title: Change failed
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/work-items/changes/failed, application/json, with which an adapter reports that it could not post the comment of a comment entry of the change feed (changes.schema.json) on its item, and stopped trying. The control plane marks that comment not posted, with reason, and keeps it with the item's other comments. The adapter sends the report after a failure that trying again cannot fix, and, after a failure that may pass, once its retries end, with reason unreachable. It sends one report for one comment entry, and none for a comment it posted. The control plane decides rights first, in the order of refusal.schema.json: a request the access key may not make is answered 403 forbidden. The request has no connection_id and no collection_ref, so connection_unknown, connection_ended, connection_suspended and collection_not_linked do not apply to it. A comment_id that is not the comment_id of a comment entry in the adapter's change feed, and one of a comment that the control plane already matched to a posted comment (source-item-comments.schema.json, comment_id), are answered with the signed 204 and change nothing, so a repeated or late report is never an error. On success the control plane answers a signed 204 with no body. The adapter acts on each answer as follows. On the signed 204, it does not send the report again. On 403 forbidden or 400 invalid_request, it stops sending the report. On a transient failure, no answer, a 5xx or an unsigned answer, it sends the report again, built anew as definitions.schema.json describes a retry, with backoff, and on a signed 429 it waits the seconds of Retry-After first. The adapter logs each refusal with the comment_id, and never with the comment's text, an access key or a secret. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

comment_id.description: The comment_id of the comment entry whose comment the adapter could not post.

reason.description: Why the adapter could not post the comment: item_gone, the item is no longer at the source, as after it was deleted; not_permitted, the source does not let the integration's account comment on the item; too_long, the comment with the adapter's first line is longer than the source allows for a comment; unreachable, the source did not answer or was busy each time the adapter tried, until its retries ended.
